packageRules.description: SAFE class (dev tooling). devDependencies (test runners, linters, @types, build tooling) on patch & minor. A bad devDep can only break CI, which is visible and never runs in production. OBSERVE MODE: labelled 'automerge-candidate' but automerge stays FALSE. To enable auto-merge later, change the 'automerge' line below to true.

SAFE class (GitHub Actions). Patch and digest bumps to pinned GitHub Actions. Actions run only in CI, never in production. OBSERVE MODE: labelled 'automerge-candidate' but automerge stays FALSE. To enable auto-merge later, change the 'automerge' line below to true.
NEVER-AUTOMERGE class (runtime npm deps). Production npm dependencies. A runtime bump can pass CI and still break production; green CI only proves the covered code paths. Always human-reviewed.
NEVER-AUTOMERGE class (Go modules). Go has no dev/prod split, so every Go module is treated as runtime/production code. Always human-reviewed.
NEVER-AUTOMERGE class (deploy/runtime surface). Docker base images, docker-compose, Terraform providers/modules and CircleCI orbs all ship to or provision production. Always human-reviewed.
NEVER-AUTOMERGE class (majors). Every major update, in any manager, no matter how small the version jump — this rule is last so it overrides the SAFE rules above for any major. Always human-reviewed.
